About this species: Rumex vesicarius is an annual herb that appears in dry sandy soils, disturbed ground, desert margins, and semi-arid habitats, especially after rainfall. It is known in several regions as an edible leafy plant and has nutritional value as a source of minerals, vitamins, and plant compounds. The species grows quickly during favorable seasons and then completes its life cycle before severe drought returns. It is a useful example of a desert annual adapted to short windows of moisture availability.
